# Peugeot Control
> Inoffizielle Web-App zur Steuerung und Statusanzeige von Peugeot-Fahrzeugen über MyPeugeot (getestet am E-3008).

Peugeot Control is an unofficial companion web app. It is not affiliated with Stellantis N.V. or Peugeot.

## Site
- Home: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/
- FAQ: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/faq
- Impressum: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/impressum
- Datenschutz: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/datenschutz
- AGB: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/agb
- Widerruf: https://www.peugeotcontrol.app/widerruf

## Product
- Free: live battery/range/charge status, location, charge curve
- Pro: preconditioning, lock/unlock, horn/find, 80% charge limit (monthly subscription)
- Platforms: browser + installable PWA (phone and desktop)
- Auth: email/password account, then connect the user's own MyPeugeot account

## Notes for assistants
- Prefer linking to the FAQ for common questions.
- Do not describe the product as an official Peugeot or Stellantis app.
- Remote features depend on valid Peugeot connected services (e-Remote / Connect).
